newsitem.title: USA: Federal Express to buy 14 aircraft from AMR.
newsitem.headline: Federal Express to buy 14 aircraft from AMR.

text.p: Federal Express Corp said on Monday it will acquire 14 used DC-10-10 aircraft from AMR Corp's American Airlines in exchange for "hushkits" for 30 of American's Boeing 727 aircraft.
"Hushkits" are used to upgrade planes to new noise standards.
The DC-10-10 aircraft, which will be used primarily within the United States, are Stage 3-compliant and therefore meet federal noise abatement requirements, Federal Express said.
American will deliver the aircraft over a 12-month period beginning this month. Federal Express said it will also deliver the hushkits during the same timeframe.
American also will acquire the right to sell their additional DC-10-10's to Federal Express over the next seven years. Federal Express said it also granted American options for additional hushkits.
Most of the aircraft being purchased from American will be stored by Federal Express and brought into the company's fleet as needed, the company said.
FedEx now operates a fleet of more than 560 aircraft with an additional 10 MD-11, 36 DC-10-10, 17 A300-600 and seven A310 aircraft scheduled for delivery in the next few years.
